title.zh: 第一款健身 App：从想法到看得见
title.en: A first fitness app: from idea to something visible

category.zh: 移动应用与 Web · 新手协作

summary.zh: 用户第一次开发应用，希望管理训练计划，并逐步提出免费方案、登录方式、设计预览与笔记整理要求。
summary.en: A first-time app creator wants workout planning, then adds budget preferences, login methods, a visual preview, and organized project notes.

why.zh: 目标来自日常生活，但需求尚未完整。Agent 需要帮助澄清，并遵守用户已有的工作习惯。
why.en: The everyday goal starts underspecified. The agent must help clarify it while respecting the user’s existing workflow.

artifact.adaptations: Added a restrictive preview CSP. Fitness mockup only: compiled original Tailwind theme locally, localized icon fonts and avatar, and removed external font loading. No task logic repaired.

visualNote.zh: 来自历史消息 #47 的 HTML 设计稿，#48 确认创建成功。外部样式、图标和头像已本地化；保留原设计。姓名、数值、账号及功能文案均为原稿中的界面示例，不代表真实用户、实测结果或已实现功能。
visualNote.en: Recovered from the HTML mockup in message #47, confirmed in #48. External styles, icons, and avatar are localized while preserving the design. Names, values, accounts, and feature copy are mockup examples, not real users, measurements, or implemented capabilities.

zh: 区分可查看的设计稿与完整可用的 App
解释步骤并尊重尽量免费的偏好
把资料整理进已有目录，避免重复创建同名目录
en: Distinguish a viewable mockup from a working app
Explain next steps and respect the low-cost preference
Organize material in the existing vault without duplicating it

takeaway.zh: 生成设计稿之后，用户指出又在现有笔记目录里创建了同名目录。协作体验还取决于是否正确理解已有环境。
takeaway.en: After the design is created, the user reports a duplicate vault inside the existing vault. Collaboration quality also depends on understanding the existing environment.

turns.original: quiero crear una app para gestionar y crear rutinas como gym, calistenia o en casa.

title.zh: 第一次做 App，希望得到引导

translation.zh: 想做一款管理健身房、徒手和居家训练计划的 App，并提供网页版；希望 Agent 随进展提出建议。
translation.en: Build an app and website for gym, calisthenics, and home workouts, with ongoing guidance from the agent.

focus.zh: 用户需要的不只是执行代码。
focus.en: The user needs more than code execution.

turns.original: quiero que la mayoria de cosas que hagamos sean gratuitas para ahorrar costes

title.zh: 逐步明确成本与登录方式

translation.zh: 尽量采用免费方案节约成本；同一轮提出邮箱密码、Apple 和 Google 登录，并继续澄清 MVP。
translation.en: Prefer free options to reduce costs. The same turn requests email/password, Apple, and Google sign-in while clarifying the MVP.

focus.zh: 约束和范围在讨论中形成。
focus.en: Constraints and scope form through discussion.

title.zh: 先做 HTML，让我看到设计

translation.zh: 先生成 HTML，让我看看设计。随后历史记录里出现了可查看的设计稿。
translation.en: Create HTML so I can see the design. A viewable mockup follows in the historical record.

focus.zh: 可视化预览帮助用户继续判断。
focus.en: A visible preview helps the user make further decisions.

turns.original: porque has creado otra carpeta llamada MiVault en la carpeta MiVault que ya existia?

title.zh: 为什么在已有目录里又建了同名目录？
title.en: Why create a vault inside my existing vault?

translation.zh: 用户指出在已有 MiVault 内又创建了一个 MiVault，质疑资料组织方式。
translation.en: The user questions why another MiVault was created inside the existing MiVault.

focus.zh: 遵守已有工作区结构，也是交付的一部分。
focus.en: Respecting the existing workspace is part of delivery.

source.note: Source indices identify historical messages, not benchmark evaluation rounds. Translations and display summaries are editorial.
